source.title: Hydrogen isotope inventory evaluation of hydrogen isotopes separation system of CFETR using Aspen Plus simulator
source.impurity_extension: Impurity extension: declared demonstration basis (1% CO + 0.5% N2) plus 0.5% He-4 for the top-vent demonstration. Impurity fractions are of the TOTAL feed; hydrogen-isotope fractions below are relative to the D2/DT sub-mixture (the 6-species column solve uses the renormalised D2/DT feed; impurities are handled by the impurity disposition layer, see h2iso.impurities).

feed.name: NBI
feed.description: Neutral Beam Injection exhaust gas, fed to ISS-I CD2 at stage 37, with trace impurities
feed.impurities_notes: Declared demonstration basis: 1% CO + 0.5% N2 (fractions of the total feed). 0.5% He-4 added to exercise the non-condensable path. CO and N2 freeze out in the 23-25 K column (triple points 68.2 / 63.2 K); He-4 is supercritical (T_c = 5.2 K) and leaves with the top product. See the impurity disposition documentation sec. 3.3 for the corrected acceptance semantics.

He4.note: Non-condensable (K = inf in h2iso terms). Dilutes the top product by a relative ~He mole fraction.

CO.note: T_tp = 68.16 K >> column window: solid. No published solubility in liquid hydrogen (literature gap) -> conservative fully-frozen default.

N2.note: T_tp = 63.15 K >> column window: solid. Dissolved trace capped at ~0.3 ppm of the liquid flow (published solubility in LH2 at 20 K).

acceptance_semantics.original_claim: impurities 99% leave via the top vent; top H2 purity change < 0.5%
acceptance_semantics.corrected: The 99%-to-top claim holds only for the helium isotopes. CO/CH4/N2 freeze out at 19-30 K (physical, not a model limitation) and must be reported as deposition risks. Verified: He -> top with dilution <= He feed fraction; CO/N2 -> frozen-out flags with warnings; baseline 6-species solve unchanged.
